agent: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md, this repository) — fix: V8 and explain's own loop detection miss a ROUTE otherwise loop
summary_for_principal:
A small, separate fix found while building the previous PR's example.

A loop can be declared two ways on a routing step: on one of its named branches, or on its fallback ('otherwise'). The system's own checker for bad loop settings (an impossible budget, or a setting that only makes sense elsewhere) only ever looked at the named-branch kind — a loop declared on the fallback passed unchecked. The same blind spot existed in the command that explains a process back to a person: it silently left such a loop out of its own listing.

Fixed both, test first (confirmed each failed before the fix, passes after). Full test suite: 392 passed, 3 new.

Numbered actions:
1. Nothing needs deciding right now.

Two new regression tests (zero budget, counts: FAILURES) for a loop declared on `otherwise`, confirmed failing before the fix.
One new regression test proving `explain` now lists a loop declared on `otherwise`, confirmed failing before the fix.
